description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Western Virginia Water Authority is hiring an IT Software Developer Trainee to develop, analyze, and troubleshoot application software and systems. The role delivers assigned development tasks, provides first-line application and technical support, and assists Authority divisions with technology improvements.
Software Developer Trainee building and maintaining applications and automated workflows with SQL, Laserfiche, and SharePoint

Responsibilities:
• Assists with development, creation and updating of functional programs and applications
• Writes clean, efficient, and well-documented code that provides best performance
• Assists with development of automated workflows using applications such as MSSQL, Oracle SQL, Laserfiche and Microsoft 365/SharePoint as core platforms
• Design test plans
• Performs IT unit testing
• Troubleshoots and debugs applications
• Installs, upgrades, maintains, and troubleshoots software applications
• Provides first-line user support software applications
• Writes user documentation to support programs
• Performs all assigned duties within allotted timeframes
• Develops basic reports or extracts files using data sources such as T-SQL in Microsoft SQL Management Studio, Oracle SQL or Microsoft SQL Reporting Services platform (SSRS)
• Accurately document programming and code changes

Requirements:
• An Associates degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology or Computer Science, or one (1) or more years of related experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
• Must possess working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as C#, Java, or VB.NET
• Working knowledge of data models, relational database structure, with applications such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle SQL, T-SQL, and SSRS
• Must have some experience with a relational database such as MSSQL (T-SQL), MYSQL, Oracle SQL and/or Microsoft SharePoint development
• Ability to write maintenance and user documentation
• Ability to develop and execute IT unit testing
• Ability to read, analyze and interpret common scientific and/or technical journals, financial reports and legal documents
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability
• Ability to be a team player with excellent communication skills and ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, employees, other Water Authority departments, contractors and the general public
• Must have great attention to detail and time-management skills
• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
• Ability to commit to milestone delivery timelines and produce reliable estimates for assigned work
• Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies
• Ability to think logically, plan strategically, analyze information, and solve complex technical problems
• Must possess and maintain a good work ethic concerning attendance, punctuality, positive attitude, meeting deadlines, being a team player and encouraging teamwork among employees
• An Associate degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology or Computer Science, or one (1) or more years of related experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
• Must possess a valid Virginia driver's license or have the ability to obtain one within 30 days of employment date. No more than six (6) demerit points on driving record if required to drive Water Authority vehicles

Preferred:
• Some experience in developing and building applications is desirable
